children: Chris Wood, Jefferies' global head of equity strategy, said he continues to favor the “picks and shovels” trade as long as capital spending holds up, according to Bloomberg.
He also said China’s domestic market gives it an edge in the AI cycle. Wood made the comments on the sidelines of the KBFG Korea Conference in Seoul.

title: Jefferies’ Chris Wood Keeps Favoring ‘Picks and Shovels’ Trade
